column1: # vox vocabulary: wrong<TAB>right, applied to transcripts after transcription.
# MacWhisper's CLI has no --vocabulary/--prompt flag and no replacement
# dictionary in its preferences, so names it reliably mangles are corrected
# here instead. Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive (see merge.py).
# Add a pair only for a mangling you have actually seen in a transcript: every
# entry is a rewrite that fires on ordinary prose too, so "admit" -> "Admyt"
# is a deliberate trade you make per name, not a guess.
